keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Barcelona 1, Getafe 0. Anthony Gordon (Barcelona) right footed shot from outside the box to the centre of the goal.
Goal! Barcelona 2, Getafe 0. Gabriel Jesus (Barcelona) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner.
Kiko Femenía (Getafe) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Zaid Romero (Getafe).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Getafe. Abdel Abqar replaces Zaid Romero because of an injury.
Delay in match because of an injury Abdel Abqar (Getafe).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Johan Mojica (Getafe) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Barcelona 2, Getafe 0.
Dani Olmo (Barcelona) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Barcelona. Fermín López replaces Gavi.
Substitution, Barcelona. Pedri replaces Dani Olmo.
Delay in match (Barcelona).
Delay in match (Getafe).
Substitution, Getafe. Martín Satriano replaces Iván Azón.
Substitution, Getafe. Davinchi replaces Johan Mojica.
Substitution, Getafe. Sebastián Boselli replaces Andrés García.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Sebastián Boselli (Getafe) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Barcelona. Marc Bernal replaces Rodri.
Substitution, Barcelona. Karim Adeyemi replaces Anthony Gordon.

Goal! Barcelona 3, Getafe 0. Jules Koundé (Barcelona) left footed shot from very close range to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Lamine Yamal with a cross following a corner.Goal confirmed following VAR Review.
Ramón Terrats (Getafe) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Barcelona. Hamza Abdelkarim replaces Gabriel Jesus.
Substitution, Getafe. Saba Sazonov replaces Kiko Femenía.
Fermín López (Barcelona) is shown the yellow card.
Second Half ends, Barcelona 3, Getafe 0.

commentary.text: Goal! Barcelona 1, Getafe 0. Anthony Gordon (Barcelona) right footed shot from outside the box to the centre of the goal.
Attempt blocked. Gavi (Barcelona) right footed shot from the centre of the box is blocked. Assisted by Anthony Gordon.
Attempt missed. Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) left footed shot from the right side of the box is high and wide to the left.
Attempt blocked. Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) left footed shot from the centre of the box is blocked. Assisted by Gavi.
